title: #lumen-eng: Auth v2 PM sign-off received — targeting merge this week

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Good news: PM signed off on the scopes schema Friday. Auth v2 implementation is complete — PR #31 is in code review with dev and kai. If review goes smoothly, we're targeting merge by end of week. Atlas has been notified.

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: Reviewing now. The v1→v2 migration path is clean. One question: are we sending a deprecation header on v1 responses now, or waiting until after Atlas migrates?

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: We'll add the Deprecation header to v1 responses as soon as PR #31 merges. The header text: 'This endpoint is deprecated and will be removed on 2026-06-15. Please migrate to /api/auth/tokens/v2.' Atlas knows, we've been in sync.

title: #lumen-eng: Design token migration nearly done — skeleton loaders unblocked

messages.author: kai-zhang
messages.text: Design token migration (PR #34) is 90% done. Final pass on the form components and we're ready. Merging should unblock skeleton loaders — dev, you should be able to start using the tokens by Thursday.

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: Perfect — I've already got the skeleton loader components drafted in a branch. Just need the tokens to land. LMNE-24 should be Done by end of sprint.

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Quick heads up: React 18.3 upgrade (PR #37) and the data grid fix (PR #35) both merged Monday. Two nice wins to open the week.

title: #lumen-eng: e2e test CI flakiness — auth service 503s

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: Playwright e2e tests (PR #36) are hitting intermittent 503s from the auth service in CI. Not clear if it's the auth service or CI networking. Opened LMNE-25 to track. Blocking the PR from merging until we understand it.

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: The auth service in CI uses a shared staging environment — it's been flaky for weeks. We should probably mock auth in the e2e environment for reliability. Worth filing a separate infrastructure ticket.
